Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct shift in the level of the data (a step change) starting around index 480-490. The values jump from fluctuating around 0-5 mm to fluctuating around 10-17 mm. This sustained deviation represents an anomaly range relative to the previous baseline.

The anomaly begins just before index 500 and continues to the end of the plotted data.
